frozen_decision_thresholds.derivation: from the champion's historical per-date IC std (~0.197 CH) and its book-level noise: dIC of 0.005 is ~7% of the mean CH IC and inside one HAC SE for a 137-date paired sample; 0.010 (~15%) with a consistent multi-metric direction is treated as material. Sharpe-like metrics over ~6 blocks are reported but are NOT decisive.
frozen_decision_thresholds.PARITY_OK: dIC_mean(B-A) >= -0.005 (or negative but within 1 HAC SE of 0) AND dPosFrac >= -0.05 AND consecutive-refit rank corr(B) >= 0.90 AND top-quintile overlap(B) >= 0.70 AND dTurnover <= +0.05 AND dMaxDD <= +3pp
frozen_decision_thresholds.PRODUCTION_RESEARCH_PARITY_RISK: dIC_mean(B-A) <= -0.010 AND dIC below -1 HAC SE AND at least two of: dPosFrac <= -0.05; dSpread20 <= -0.5pp; rank corr(B) < 0.80 or overlap(B) < 0.50; dTurnover > +0.10
frozen_decision_thresholds.PARITY_WARNING: anything else (material movement without consistent direction/evidence)
frozen_decision_thresholds.better_than_A: if B is materially better, record it; it does not change the champion references (they would be conservative)
frozen_decision_thresholds.note: thresholds fixed before the run; not to be tuned afterwards
